US/EU indie teams conflate system battery features with storefront language. iOS Settings and App Store Connect actually separate them:

  • Low Power Mode on the device — user-toggle under Settings → Battery → Low Power Mode that reduces background activity, defers mail fetch, lowers screen brightness, and shows the yellow battery icon in the status bar. System battery behavior — outside AppLocale scope.

Official Settings vocabulary

Apple's zh-Hans Settings UI uses 低电量模式 for Low Power Mode, with related buyer language around 低电量 (low battery), 省电模式 (power-saving mode), 节省电量 (save battery), and 黄色电池图标 (yellow battery icon) for the status-bar indicator. Listing copy should mirror that vocabulary — not generic 省电 alone that could mean Optimized Battery Charging, Background App Refresh settings, or unrelated power features.

Battery Health maximum capacity percentages and Optimized Battery Charging scheduling live under the same Battery settings pane but serve different buyer intent from the Low Power Mode toggle. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 电池健康 or 优化电池充电 when your English source only shows a Low Power Mode switch and reduced-background-activity badge.
